title: RBP Observability Integration
notes: RBP's autonomous execution loops (`ralph.sh` and `ralph-execute.sh`) currently lack real-time observability. Users cannot see what Ralph is doing without manually tailing `progress.txt` or running `bd status` repeatedly.
